machines.name: Brother PR (6-needle)
machines.source: Brother's PR680W product page and brochure (frames 300 × 200, 180 × 130, 100 × 100 and 60 × 40 mm). PR manuals: the machine ships set to delete stitches of 0.3 mm or less.

machines.name: Husqvarna Viking Designer Jade 35
machines.source: The Designer Jade 35 product page. The format it reads isn't confirmed, so none is set.

machines.name: Melco Summit
machines.source: Melco's Summit manual: the largest sewing field. Add your own hoops in a machine of your own. Shortest stitch from a shop running one, which reports it drops stitches under 0.4 mm.

machines.name: ZSK Sprint 8
machines.source: ZSK's Sprint 8 catalog (tubular field) and its list of the codes the T8 control reads.

machines.name: Commercial machine (DST)
machines.source: No one machine: Tajima's DST and common frame sizes, for Tajima, Barudan, Ricoma, Happy and others until they have profiles of their own. Shortest stitch 0.4 mm: above the 0.3 mm Brother's PR machines delete as they come, and what a shop reports for its Melco.
